scope: Independent native CPU RRB byte/invariant audit; preserves failed run gates

scalar_audit.scope: Sequential scalar reconstruction of exact saved RRB payload/envelope bytes versus host reference/source and available client output. No display, source-app, acquisition-authenticity or latency claim.

errors: complete stereo receive-to-submit p95 must be strictly below 15 ms
render-attempt accounting contains an aborted or unaccounted attempt
trace joins do not preserve the full presentation prefix

limitations: Post-foveation source equality is not original application-to-display equality.
Native summary latency/trace verdicts are retained, not repaired or promoted by this audit.
Same-render submitted-reference pixel comparison remains a separate bound stage.
One chroma-grid run does not meet two-repeat/three-family/full-stage quality requirements.
No optical display, human-visible artifact or new wireless-transport claim.
